summary: Curtis Institute of Music in Philadelphia gives every student a full-tuition scholarship, whatever their nationality or finances: $55,995 a year for undergraduates and $69,527 for graduate students in 2026–27. Need-based aid can cover living costs for students who qualify. Admission is by application and audition, and about 4 percent of applicants get in. Applications close on 10 December, with live auditions in Philadelphia in February and March.
meta_title: Curtis Institute of Music: free tuition for international students
meta_description: Every Curtis student, international ones included, studies tuition-free, and need-based aid can cover living costs. Apply by 10 December, then audition.
covers: A full-tuition scholarship for every admitted student: $55,995 a year for undergraduates and $69,527 for graduate students in 2026–27.
Need-based financial assistance that can cover all living expenses for students who qualify; Curtis says 85% of its students qualify for aid.
eligibility: Musicians of any nationality. International students also receive the full-tuition scholarship, and nearly 40 percent of Curtis students come from abroad.
Programmes: Diploma, Bachelor of Music, Master of Music, Post-Baccalaureate Diploma and an opera Professional Studies Certificate.
Admission depends on your application and audition; the overall acceptance rate is about 4 percent.
how_to_apply: Apply online by 10 December with prescreening recordings (every instrument except oboe) and an unofficial transcript.
If invited, audition in person in Philadelphia. For fall 2027, auditions run from 21 February to 16 March 2027, with conducting on 9 April.
For help with living costs, submit the CSS Profile with your parents' information.
Send recommendations and unofficial transcripts by 31 December; official transcripts and test scores are due by 15 July.
watch_out: The scholarship covers tuition only; housing, food and fees need your own money or need-based aid.
Curtis prints the 10 December deadline without a year, so confirm it on the admissions page.
There are no regional auditions: finalists audition on campus in Philadelphia.
Applications after the deadline are considered case by case and cost an extra $75.
costs: Housing, food, fees and living costs
You, or Curtis need-based aid if you qualify
You, unless Curtis grants a fee waiver for significant financial need (request it by 3 December)
Travel to Philadelphia for a live audition
US student visa: $185 application fee and $350 SEVIS fee, plus a new $250 visa integrity fee that some embassies now charge
documents: The online application with prescreening recordings (not needed for oboe)
An unofficial transcript, and recommendations by 31 December

English test scores after admission, for placement: TOEFL iBT 4 (new scale) or 79–80 (old scale), IELTS 6.5–7.0 in each area, or Cambridge 169. After at least three years at an English-language school you can ask for an exemption
The CSS Profile with your parents' information, if you need help with living costs

faq.q: Do international students get free tuition at Curtis?
faq.a: Yes. Every admitted student receives a full-tuition scholarship, regardless of nationality or finances.
Not automatically. Need-based assistance can cover all living expenses for students who qualify, through the CSS Profile.

faq.q: Do I need TOEFL or IELTS to apply?
faq.a: No. Test scores are not required for admission; Curtis uses them after acceptance to place you in a programme.
